Clipboard Float uses design resources adapted from Filee:
https://github.com/KnifeLemon/Filee

Upstream source files retained here under the MIT license:
- DonutGeometry.cs: clockwise-from-top polar layout, angular hit testing,
  constant visual gap between inner/outer radii.
- DonutMenu.cs: substepped spring integration (320 stiffness / 20 damping),
  7-pixel hover pop-out, critically damped dismissal.
- Soft.axaml and SoftPalette.cs: warm neutral surfaces and #7F77DD accent.

The Python port is in filee_motion.py. Qt-native painting, clipboard previews,
keyboard navigation and the clipboard data layer are this application's code.
This is an independent clipboard utility, not an official Filee release.

Adapted upstream commit: 55d76521f6ea13738d69cd6bc40e3e4f24f876c1
